messages:
maya: Quick sync — FYI: obs roadmap runway for next sprint. Need clear owners for three things: dashboard templates for error analysis, trace hook rollout (backend libs + frontend markers), and retention cutover (30d -> 14d for traces). Posting asks and blockers.
jordan: assigning me for dashboard templates. I'll make PRs for the error-analysis views by Tue. Need sample queries and expected counts.
maya: thx. Jordan, can you copy our sample queries from staging? here's example query to use in Grafana:
```sql
select service, count(*) as errors
from traces
where duration_ms > 1000 and status = 'error'
group by service
order by errors desc
limit 20;
```
sam: I'm owner for trace hooks rollout. Current blockers: instrumentation lib v2 needs one more compatibility patch from eng-runtime. @dinesh can you confirm ETA on the patch?
dinesh: Patch is queued, ETA Wed EOD. There's a subtle header change; I'll drop a small PR today. Heads up: it touches request-id propagation — test coverage required.
lea: retention cutover — I can own the config and rollout. Proposal: phased cutover per env:
- staging: 30 -> 14 day retention tomorrow
- canary: next Tue
- prod: Fri (requires infra approval)
PR for config:
```yaml
trace_retention_days: 14
sampling_rate: 0.75
```
todd: infra approval: need to confirm SLO impact on long-tail queries. Lea, can you open a ticket with estimated cost delta and expected query failures? opsbot will schedule a review.
opsbot: deploy-review requested — ticket #OBS-412 created, reviewers: @todd, @sam, @jordan.
maya: two quick Qs: 1) fallback if new trace hooks cause noise? 2) any dashboards that must ship before prod cutover?
sam: 1) fallback plan is to set sampling_rate back to 1.0 and temporarily route to legacy ingest. Need an emergency playbook. 2) Jordan pls prioritize the "errors-by-release" panel.
jordan: will do. Also want to surface a small UI change — labels for "service" field differ between envs. I'll add normalization step in the dashboard queries.
dinesh: PR incoming for header compat — will add unit tests. Sam, can you run the canary trace sampling for one service only initially?
sam: yes - I'll wire it to "search-service" canary tomorrow.
todd: scheduling infra review Thu 9am PT. If all good, prod cutover remains Fri. Please add any blocking items to ticket #OBS-412.
maya: awesome — let's check back EOD Wed. Thanks team :rocket:
